unit_note: plan4_dev only: 30 families with three versions each. plan4_hold is unused. Same written A on every branch. 2 position conventions x 2 framing conditions x with/without the first four positions, plus full KV, result text, and four-only.

decision.note: A qualifying candidate needs parseable untruncated outputs in every case and all-label accuracy within five points of full KV and result text. Smallest message wins; handoff time breaks ties. This selects a confirmation candidate; it does not itself establish recovery.

framing_change: Use the preceding carrier results together with the shipment information below.
lead: Parseability, truncation, all-four eligibility, final-choice accuracy, and correct-choice-with-wrong-labels are reported separately. Malformed outputs stay in the denominator.
timing_note: mean_process_time_s includes written A, gather/re-rotation, and B. Network is not measured.
after_this_run: If a compact candidate qualifies, freeze it for confirmation and cost. If none qualifies, proceed to supporting context. Do not load plan4_hold.
